metrics.acceptance: experiment q17_accept: zero-shot and every candidate form (bindw4@rho0.7_approach_src<k>) on init states 0-9, 10 episodes, noise seed 3; keep the most successes, ties to the policy, then the earlier candidate
metrics.context: the 48 tasks are those of the broad screen q9_w4screen (states 0-9, seed 0, seen); q13_main and q16_library read 9 of them; all episodes here are new (seed 3)

hypotheses.H1: order A: kept > zero-shot pooled over the 48 arrivals (exact sign test on discordant pairs)
hypotheses.H3 (descriptive): a demonstration for every task (candidate: its own prototype): kept vs zero-shot

metrics.reported: demonstrations requested per order (planned: {"A": 15, "B": 15} of 48), bytes stored (4 KB per requested prototype), forms kept
metrics.rule: an arrival whose object type is not in the library requests one demonstration, used once: its first grasp gives a 4 KB object prototype (experiments/q4_template.py) that joins the library and is its only candidate; an arrival whose type is known requests nothing and its candidates are up to K=4 library prototypes of the type (same scene first, then other scenes, each in arrival order)
metrics.test: experiment q17_main: the kept arm and zero-shot on init states 30-49, 20 episodes, noise seed 3 (a kept policy reuses the zero-shot episodes)
metrics.written_before: any episode of q17_accept or q17_main
